name: jobsearchos
description: A personal job-search operating system. /setup interviews you once and builds your own profile, voice guide, proof-project pillars and branded letter templates. /fast-letter turns a job link into a sendable letter, /log-application keeps your filing structure and tracker honest, and optional modules add deep research, warm intros, interview prep and an overnight job sweep. Nothing personal ships in the package: everything comes from your own profile folder.
